parsed.doc_summary: Morgan Lewis law-firm alert (Aug 21, 2026) on algorithmic rent-pricing laws. In-scope: SF §37.10C, San Diego §§98.1101-98.1104, Berkeley ch. 13.63, Santa Ana NS-3090, Jersey City §218-12, Hoboken ch. 158. Berkeley effective date is given here as January 2026 (conflicts with ordinance text March 1, 2026).

rules.title: SF ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use qualifying algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants can sue for damages, injunctions and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each unit-month a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; up to $1,000 per violation
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month per affected unit may be a separate violation; damages and injunctive relief
rules.effective_date_note: Document says 'effective October 2024'; exact day not given.

rules.title: San Diego algorithmic rent-setting prohibition
rules.requirement: San Diego prohibits use of rent-setting algorithmic devices relying on nonpublic competitor data. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief and penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and property potentially a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation; damages and injunctive relief
rules.effective_date_note: Document says 'effective June 2025'; exact day not given.

rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Berkeley prohibits coordinated rent-pricing algorithms. Violations can recur per unit per month and carry private remedies.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies
rules.effective_date_note: This law-firm alert says January 2026; the ordinance text reportedly says March 1, 2026. Prefer the official text date if confirmed. The alert also notes RealPage v. City of Berkeley was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026.
rules.conflict_note: Two published effective dates: January 2026 (this alert) vs. March 1, 2026 (ordinance text).

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Santa Ana prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing. Tenants may bring private claims for up to $1,000 per violation per month.
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.key_value: up to $1,000 per violation per month
rules.penalty: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month; private tenant claims

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. Enforced publicly and privately, with fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.effective_date_note: Document says 'effective June 2025'; exact day not given.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43, eff. 7/1/2027) may preempt this ordinance; not discussed in this document.

rules.title: Hoboken ban on rent-coordinating software
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.citation: Hoboken City Code ch. 158, Art. II
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.key_value: ban on software/algorithms/data-sharing platforms coordinating rents
rules.effective_date_note: Document says 'effective July 2025'; exact day not given.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act may preempt this ordinance once effective; not discussed in this document.
